modifications: One SparkRenderer per owning scene with an aggregate LOD splat budget; no scene pixel-ratio mutation.
Abort fetches and guard late decoder completion, source replacement and scene teardown.
Retain full original splats temporarily for all-source Gaussian-extent bounds; release original buffers after measuring and retain the LOD hierarchy.
Use covariance splats for nonuniform artwork transforms, a child PI rotation for legacy axes, and transform-preserving box SDF cutouts.
Release the owned SplatMesh edit SDF texture omitted by Spark 2.4 dispose.
Track every generated compute pipeline used by each mesh and dispose its cached compute material on mesh release.
Guard system initialization for scenes without arjs attribute.
Use local pinned Hiro marker and camera calibration data.
Own and remove session/system resize/video/render listeners and polling timer.
Stop camera tracks and dispose controller on remove and on late camera permission.
Resolve both external Three imports through ./aframe-three-bridge.js and the matching local ./three-Pass.js.
Remove the source-map footer because its optional developer map is not shipped.
Export releaseSplatWorkerPool to terminate only idle decoder workers on final scene release or canceled decode completion; active loads are untouched.

embeddedAssets.wasm: Base64-inlined spark_rs_bg.wasm, compiled by WebAssembly.compile; no external WASM URL.
embeddedAssets.worker: Inline worker source created as a local Blob URL with a data URL fallback; no external worker URL.

modifications: Resolve the external Three import through ./aframe-three-bridge.js.

threeBridge.source: Local ES module bindings to window.AFRAME.THREE; no second Three runtime.
